senses.gloss: Udvaha^1, a prince. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2700 (among the incarnations from the Krodhavaśa gaṇa).

Udvaha^2, name of a wind. § 714j (Śakakṛtya): The wind which causes Soma (the Moon) and other luminaries to arise (in the body called Udāna (so C.)), and which sucks up the waters in the oceans and imparts them to the clouds and thereafter to Parjanya, is called U.: XII, 329, 12404.
